description: This file contains unit tests for the Placeholders utility class, verifying detection of placeholder patterns in strings.

classes.name: PlaceholdersTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that tests methods in the Placeholders utility class, specifically the containsAnyPlaceholder method.

methods.name: containsReturnsTrueWhenInputContainsPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly identifies a string containing a placeholder pattern.

methods.name: containsReturnsTrueWhenInputContainsLegacyPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests detection of legacy placeholder pattern in input string.

methods.name: containsReturnsTrueWhenInputContainsBothNewAndLegacyPlaceholders
methods.description: Verifies detection when input contains both new and legacy placeholders.

methods.name: containsReturnsFalseWhenInputContainsPlaceholderStartOnly
methods.description: Checks that incomplete placeholder start pattern is not falsely detected.

methods.name: containsReturnsFalseWhenInputContainsPlaceholderEndOnly
methods.description: Checks that incomplete placeholder end pattern is not falsely detected.

methods.name: containsReturnsFailsWhenInputDoesNotContainAnyPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that no false positives occur when input contains no placeholders.
